text: The sky appears blue due to a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, where shorter wavelengths of light (blue and violet) are scattered in all directions by the gases and particles in the Earth's atmosphere. This scattering is more pronounced for blue light, which is why the sky appears blue to our eyes.
